_rule: VERBATIM ONLY. Every string in `text` must be something Suresh Vuyyuru actually published. Do not smooth grammar, do not modernize, do not merge two quotes into one. If you want him to say something else, ask him to say it.

quotes.text: Public service is my passion and my calling.

My name is Suresh Vuyyuru. I am a dad, a husband, farmer and a Software Engineer. My family and I have been proud to call Mountain House home. We love living here, and my dedication to this community runs deep. Social service and involvement have been my calling and passion. I have tried to be the voice of our community over the last four years.
In 2020, during the challenging times of the pandemic, my family and I made Mountain House our home.
In the last election, our shared vision brought us close to victory, since then I have significantly increased my engagement within the community.
From thrilling volleyball matches to intense badminton and ping pong tournaments, I've worked to create sporting platforms for our residents to come together, stay active, and build connections.
Together, let's build a brighter future for Mountain House!
Remember, actions speak louder than words and media hype.
